name: Scroll-Driven Carousel Markers
description: A snap-scrolling carousel whose marker dots light up in sync with the scroll position, using a named CSS scroll-timeline hoisted with timeline-scope so sibling markers can animate over their own slice of it. Zero JavaScript.
usage: Include styles.css, then wrap an .sdcm-entries slide list and an .sdcm-markers dot list in an .sdcm-carousel with --sdcm-n set to your slide count. Give each slide an id and point each marker link at it; the dots sync to scroll automatically in supporting browsers.
